title: Toward expert-level medical question answering with large language models

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Toward expert-level medical question answering with large language models》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering, with Med-PaLM being the first to exceed a 'passing' score in United States Medical Licensing Examination style questions.
